card.name: The word Upon before starting or stopping
card.fires_on: The word "Upon" (or "upon") that opens a sentence or clause about starting, stopping or co-administering a drug, usually right after a sentence about drug interactions.

modes.label: Sentence-opening Upon
modes.description: "Upon" begins a new sentence in an interaction passage, followed by initiation, discontinuation or coadministration.
modes.example: << Upon>> initiation or discontinuation of COSENTY

modes.label: Mid-sentence upon
modes.description: "upon" follows a clause on reversible effects and precedes discontinuation of a drug.
modes.example: CNS symptoms are generally reversible within days to weeks<< upon>> discontinuation of metronidazole.

card.plain: It lights up on the word "Upon" when a label says what happens once a drug is started or stopped.
